datasets.name: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) 30 m resolution hillshade layer
datasets.verbatim: The three resulting data layers (greenest-pixel composite from pre- and post-event and rdNDVI) and a Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM)-derived 30 m resolution hillshade layer (for areas between 60° N and 60° S latitude) are added to the standard Google Earth Engine layer pane.

methods.name: HazMapper
methods.summary: HazMapper is an open-access application developed in Google Earth Engine that uses a vegetation-based metric, the relative difference in the normalized difference vegetation index (rdNDVI), to identify areas where vegetation was removed following a natural disaster. It generates greenest-pixel composites from multi-spectral satellite imagery (Landsat or Sentinel-2) to perform change detection.
methods.source: Corey M. Scheip and Karl W. Wegmann
methods.verbatim: Supporting JavaScript source code for HazMapper is available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4103348.

code_links.name: Hazmapper rapid image classification (RIC) toolset for hazard mapping
code_links.summary: Source code for the Hazmapper tool used to classify and map hazards such as mass wasting, wildfire, volcanic activity, and tsunami inundation from remote sensing imagery. Released under a research-only license.
